title: Agentic Turtles Deliverable Patch
description: The deliverable.patch artifact envelope (FR-060) — the ONLY channel by which a build's work reaches the repository. Uploaded by an executor holding contents: read; validated as untrusted input by build-publish, which holds the write scope. A FILE SET rather than a unified diff, deliberately: deliverable-gate D2 (scope containment) and D5 (subject boundary) both need the touched paths to be a fact rather than a parse, and applying a diff would put the write back in a shell with a git credential — the capability the substrate split withholds.

plan_ref.description: The frozen plan tag this build was dispatched on. Carried in the artifact because the workflow_run payload the writer is triggered by cannot see dispatch inputs. A CLAIM: D1 binds it against the triggering run's own head_sha, which the executor cannot author.

step_id.description: The one plan step this deliverable delivers. Executor-authored and therefore not trusted alone (GHI #116): D1 derives the step independently from the build's work item and refuses any disagreement.

executor_id.description: Recorded on the pull request for provenance (FR-065). Descriptive, never authorizing.

files.description: Whole files, not hunks — a hunk cannot be validated against a scope without first being applied.

path.description: Repo-relative, forward slashes. Traversal and absolute paths are REFUSED by the gate, never normalized into safety.

deletions.description: Paths this deliverable removes. Held to exactly the same scope and reserved checks as files — deleting is a write.

summary.description: One line for the deliverable commit message and PR title.
